name: small-business-site
description: A small business website with services, about and contact pages and an enquiry form, free on Cloudflare.

ENQUIRIES.description: A free KV namespace that keeps every enquiry sent through the contact form.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The password for the `/enquiries` page, where you read what people send. The user name can be anything. Use a long password.

ENQUIRY_TO.description: Optional. The inbox that gets a copy of each enquiry by email. Leave it empty for now: it works only after you set up Cloudflare Email Routing (see README).

ENQUIRY_FROM.description: Optional. The sender address for those emails, on your own domain, for example `Website <website@example.co.uk>`. Leave it empty for now.
